Feature: Register Default Values and Read/Write Access
Test Description: This test verifies default register values and read/write behavior of the PCIe SII Root Complex registers using masks and defined data patterns. It checks that readable registers match specified defaults and that writes are honored per write and read masks across multiple data patterns.
Remarks: Non-readable or non-writable registers are skipped. The PHY reset control register is excluded from the default value check. The test uses read and write masks to determine expected values. A soft reset helper exists but is not executed.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) For each register in the SII RC address list, read the register if readable and skip the PHY reset control register; compare the read value to its default value.
2) For each data pattern, write the pattern to each writable register not marked to skip.
3) For each register after writing, read the value if readable and writable, compute the expected value using the read and write masks with the stored default, and compare with the read value.
4) Record mismatches during default checks and read/write checks and determine the final result based on failure counters.

Test Description: The test configures cache coherency controls, performs optional link training, programs PCIe configuration space, and uses a handshake/status mechanism to determine completion. It polls link status bits and waits for a handshake register value to indicate completion before finishing.
Remarks: Link training is conditional on compile-time flags. Handshake uses a dedicated register. The procedure relies on status polling and does not include explicit failure asserts in configuration read/write sequences.
